2. **Social Context**: The user chose the right side when dining with a friend who was seated on their left, indicating that they prefer not to obstruct the view or interaction with the friend.

3. **Table Type Influence**: The user seems to have a consistent tendency to alternate their feeding side preferences based on the meal context (personal vs. social) and the nature of the food items presented.
